author: courses_ground

sources.title: 美國環保署配水管網模型手冊
sources.titleEn: EPA EPANET 2.2 User Manual
sources.scope: 支持延時管網、需求與水質模型；不是快速水錘求解器。
sources.scopeEn: Supports extended-period network, demand and water-quality modeling; not a rapid water-hammer solver.

sources.title: 美國墾務局焊接鋼製壓力管專論
sources.titleEn: Welded Steel Penstocks, Engineering Monograph 3
sources.scope: 支持水錘、管殼、支座及試驗原理；歷史技術指南不能替代現行地方規範。
sources.scopeEn: Supports water hammer, shell, support and testing principles; this historical guide does not replace current local requirements.

sources.title: 紐約德拉瓦輸水隧道繞道接通公告
sources.titleEn: Delaware Aqueduct Bypass Connection Update
sources.scope: 核對二〇二五年公告的漏水修復與供水協調；不宣稱繞道已接通，也不把教學閥門曲線當工程實測。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the 2025 repair and supply-coordination announcement; does not claim completed connection or project-specific teaching valve curves.

sources.title: 莫卡辛壓力輸水管更新計畫
sources.titleEn: Moccasin Penstock Project
sources.scope: 核對壓力管連結供水與發電、老舊管段及支承更新議題；現行頁列為規劃，不當竣工案例。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies combined water/power service and aging pipe/support issues; the page describes planning, not completed replacement.

sources.title: 香港智管網與分區壓力監測
sources.titleEn: Hong Kong Water Intelligent Network
sources.scope: 支持分區計量與壓力管理實際計畫；數學算例不代表香港管網的控制設定。
sources.scopeEn: Supports the actual district-metering and pressure-management programme; numerical examples are not Hong Kong control settings.

sources.title: 香港水務署水損管理
sources.titleEn: Water Loss Management
sources.scope: 支持監測、漏水控制、壓力管理和修復的多措施架構；不把無收益水全當實漏。
sources.scopeEn: Supports combined monitoring, leakage control, pressure management and repair; does not equate all non-revenue water with real leakage.

sources.title: 新加坡智慧水表首期採購公告
sources.titleEn: Singapore First-phase Smart Water Meter Announcement
sources.scope: 核對二〇二一年首期三十萬表公告；用戶水表與分區入口表屬不同量測尺度，不宣稱所有水表能聲學定位。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the 2021 announcement of 300,000 first-phase meters; customer and district meters have different scales, and customer meters are not presumed acoustic locators.

sources.title: 藍山鎮管內聲學檢測案例
sources.titleEn: Blue Mountains Inline Acoustic Inspection
sources.scope: 製造商一手案例支持管內聲學與地表相關法的差異；性能敘述屬供應者報告，不作獨立比較排名。
sources.scopeEn: Manufacturer case supports distinctions between inline acoustics and surface correlation; performance statements are supplier-reported, not independent rankings.

sources.title: 美國環保署配水系統水損控制指南
sources.titleEn: Control and Mitigation of Drinking Water Losses in Distribution Systems
sources.scope: 支持水量平衡、計量及聲學定位的技術背景；二〇一〇年指引不是本地現行法規。
sources.scopeEn: Supports water balance, metering and acoustic-location background; the 2010 guidance is not current local law.

sources.title: 香港屋苑地下公用水管測漏指引
sources.titleEn: Guideline on Leak Detection on Underground Communal Service of Housing Estates
sources.scope: 核對二〇一七年首版的聲學相關、調查與修復驗證流程；地方責任規定不外推到其他司法區。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the 2017 first edition covering acoustic correlation, investigation and repair verification; local legal responsibilities are not generalized to other jurisdictions.

sources.title: 香港青衣地下水管測漏訓練中心
sources.titleEn: Q-Leak Underground Water Mains Leak Detection Training Centre
sources.scope: 核對二〇二一年七月啟用的訓練場、不同管材與模擬漏點；不把模擬試驗成績當城市實漏準確率。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the training centre opened in July 2021, varied pipe materials and simulated leaks; training performance is not city-wide field accuracy.

sources.title: 香港水務署敷設水管實務手冊
sources.titleEn: Manual of Mainlaying Practice
sources.scope: 支持管線材料、施工介面及測漏接觸點配置；此引用明示二〇二一年修訂文件。
sources.scopeEn: Supports materials, construction interfaces and acoustic contact-point provision; this reference explicitly identifies the 2021 amendment.

sources.title: 加州海洋計畫海淡取排水資料
sources.titleEn: California Ocean Plan Desalination Provisions
sources.publisher: California State Water Resources Control Board
sources.scope: 核對二〇一五年修訂歷史及取水、鹵水與生態評估議題；本課不提供許可判定或外推加州法規。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the 2015 amendment history and intake, brine and ecological-assessment topics; lessons provide no permit determination or export of California law.

sources.title: 地下海水取水專家報告及主管機關回應
sources.titleEn: Subsurface Intake Panel Report with Agency Response
sources.publisher: California State Water Resources Control Board
sources.scope: 二〇二四年報告須連同二〇二五年五月回應閱讀；機關明示非唯一合規指南，部分程序建議並非現行要求。
sources.scopeEn: Read the 2024 report with the May 2025 agency response: it is not a sole compliance guide, and some procedural proposals are not existing requirements.

sources.title: 伯斯海水淡化廠業主資料
sources.titleEn: Perth Seawater Desalination Plant
sources.scope: 核對奎那那廠於二〇〇六年開始產水及海域監測背景；業主生態敘述不是所有取排水設計的無影響證明。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies Kwinana production starting in 2006 and marine monitoring context; owner ecological statements do not prove zero impact for all intake/outfall designs.

sources.title: 南部海水淡化廠業主資料
sources.titleEn: Southern Seawater Desalination Plant
sources.scope: 核對賓寧納普廠於二〇一一年開始產水及供水系統連接；本課數值不是該廠運轉或排放資料。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies Binningup production beginning in 2011 and supply-system connections; lesson numbers are not plant operating or discharge data.

sources.title: 美國環保署羽流二點〇理論及手冊
sources.titleEn: PLUMES 2.0 Dilution Model: Model Theory and User Manual
sources.scope: 二〇二四年手冊支持近場、遠場與稀釋定義；需另核對負浮力與接觸海床時的子模型限制。
sources.scopeEn: The December 2024 manual supports near-field, far-field and dilution definitions; negative buoyancy and seabed contact require specific submodel-limit checks.

sources.title: 墾務局取水魚類保護手冊
sources.titleEn: Fish Protection at Water Diversions
sources.scope: 二〇〇六年手冊與二〇〇九年現地評估指南支持篩網水力、排砂及驗證；特定魚種速度要求不能外推所有河川。
sources.scopeEn: The 2006 manual and 2009 field-evaluation companion support screen hydraulics, sediment handling and verification; species-specific criteria are not universal river limits.

sources.title: 陸軍工兵團泥砂起動與侵蝕門檻
sources.titleEn: HEC-RAS Critical Thresholds for Transport and Erosion
sources.scope: 支持非黏性顆粒的剪應力尺度與公式適用差異；不是以單一常數預測所有混合床或黏土。
sources.scopeEn: Supports noncohesive shear-stress scaling and formula distinctions, not one constant for all mixed beds or cohesive sediment.

sources.title: 紅崖魚類通行改善工程
sources.titleEn: Red Bluff Fish Passage Improvement Project
sources.scope: 核對二〇一二年九月抽水與篩網實質完成及移交；歷史頁的後續預定事項不當作已完成事實。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies September 2012 substantial completion and operational transfer of pumping and screens; later scheduled work on the historical page is not presumed completed.

sources.title: 弗里波特區域取水與供水工程
sources.titleEn: Freeport Regional Water Project
sources.scope: 核對二〇一一年設施完成與旱年補充供水；算例泥砂、流速與幾何均非該工程實測。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies 2011 facility completion and drought-supply context; teaching sediment, velocity and geometry are not project measurements.

sources.title: 美國地質調查局水位量測方法
sources.titleEn: Stage Measurement at Gaging Stations, TM 3-A7
sources.scope: 二〇一〇年官方出版摘要核對浮子、壓力與非接觸量測方法；機關量測目標不當作全球設備標準。
sources.scopeEn: The official 2010 publication summary verifies float, pressure and noncontact methods; agency accuracy goals are not global equipment standards.

sources.title: 香港雨水排放手冊第五版
sources.titleEn: Stormwater Drainage Manual, Fifth Edition
sources.scope: 二〇一八年官方手冊支持雨洪系統與抽水設施的整合；地方標準須配合後續修訂，不能外推為全球規範。
sources.scopeEn: The official 2018 manual supports integrated stormwater and pumping systems; local criteria require subsequent amendments and are not universal standards.

sources.title: 香港上環雨水抽水站
sources.titleEn: Sheung Wan Stormwater Pumping Station
sources.scope: 核對二〇〇九年啟用與儲水、閘門、抽排整合；未以本課假設代稱實際操作規則。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies 2009 commissioning and storage, gate and pumping integration; lesson assumptions are not actual operating rules.

sources.title: 美國地質調查局水位站高程測量
sources.titleEn: Levels at Gaging Stations, TM 3-A19
sources.scope: 二〇一〇年手冊支持基準點、儀器及水準閉合檢查；不能把感測解析度當絕對高程準確度。
sources.scopeEn: The 2010 manual supports benchmarks, instruments and leveling checks; sensor resolution is not absolute elevation accuracy.

sources.title: 科羅拉多河李斯渡口水文站
sources.titleEn: Colorado River at Lees Ferry, USGS 09380000
sources.scope: 核對真實站名與站號，僅作自動水文資料實例；課內讀值及電池假設不歸屬該站。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the real station name and identifier as a hydrometric-data example; lesson readings and battery assumptions are not attributed to the station.

sources.title: 密西西比河維克斯堡站歷史資料
sources.titleEn: Mississippi River at Vicksburg, Station History
sources.scope: 核對站號〇七二八九〇〇〇及一九七七年起橋下游位置的歷史記錄；不將歷史配置宣稱為現今全部設備。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies station 07289000 and the historical downstream-bridge location beginning in 1977; historical configuration is not presented as a complete current equipment inventory.

sources.title: 美國海洋大氣總署環境資料衛星收集系統
sources.titleEn: GOES Data Collection System Program Information
sources.scope: 核對現地平台、衛星、中繼接收與資料散布架構；不宣稱本課取得頻道或可自行連接營運網路。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the platform, satellite, receiving and distribution architecture; the course claims no channel allocation or access to the operational network.

sources.title: 工兵團抽水站機電設計手冊目錄
sources.titleEn: Mechanical and Electrical Design of Pumping Stations, EM 1110-2-3105
sources.scope: 官方目錄核對二〇二〇年四月三十日版本與機電整合範圍；未把舊同名PDF錯稱新版全文。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalogue verifies the 30 April 2020 edition and mechanical/electrical scope; an older same-named PDF is not misrepresented as the new full text.

sources.title: 西部封閉綜合工程首次風暴操作公告
sources.titleEn: West Closure Complex First Storm Operation
sources.scope: 核對二〇一二年八月二十九日閘門與抽水站首次風暴事件操作；不推定現今容量或本課控制設定。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies first storm-event operation of gates and pumping on 29 August 2012; does not infer current capacity or lesson control settings.

sources.title: 美國環保署雨洪模型水理參考手冊
sources.titleEn: SWMM Reference Manual Volume II Hydraulics
sources.scope: 二〇一七年手冊支持儲水幾何、孔口、堰及動態演算；本課手算為簡化比較，不宣稱等同完整軟體求解。
sources.scopeEn: The 2017 manual supports storage geometry, orifices, weirs and dynamic routing; hand calculations are simplifications, not equivalent to the complete software solution.

sources.title: 大坑東蓄洪計畫
sources.titleEn: Tai Hang Tung Stormwater Storage Scheme
sources.scope: 核對二〇〇四年九月啟用及離線截流、延後抽排的機制；不把教學池容或門檻當實際操作。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies September 2004 commissioning and offline interception with delayed pumping; lesson storage and thresholds are not operating values.

sources.title: 跑馬地地下蓄洪計畫啟用記錄
sources.titleEn: Happy Valley Underground Stormwater Storage Commissioning
sources.scope: 核對二〇一七年三月十六日全面啟用與地下空間整合；課內幾何和流量非工程實測。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies full commissioning on 16 March 2017 and underground-space integration; lesson geometry and flows are not project measurements.

sources.title: 曼尼托巴紅河分洪道
sources.titleEn: Manitoba Red River Floodway
sources.scope: 核對原分洪道一九六二至一九六八年施工及二〇〇五年開始擴建；不推定課內堰式或操作門檻用於該工程。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies original 1962–1968 construction and expansion beginning in 2005; lesson weir equations and operating thresholds are not attributed to the project.

sources.title: 元朗排洪繞道與河川生態
sources.titleEn: Yuen Long Bypass Floodway
sources.scope: 核對二〇〇三年開工、二〇〇六年完成與分流路徑；功能比較不宣稱課內假設斷面是實際工程尺寸。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies construction starting in 2003, completion in 2006 and diversion context; comparison sections are not real project dimensions.

sources.title: 英國臨時及可拆式防洪指引
sources.titleEn: Temporary and Demountable Flood Protection Guide, August 2011
sources.scope: 已讀二〇一一年八月報告的提前量、部署及滲漏章；資料頁標題含二〇一〇但報告版權為二〇一一年，舊產品清單非現行認證。
sources.scopeEn: Read the August 2011 report on lead time, deployment and seepage. The landing-page title says 2010, but report copyright is 2011; historical product listings are not current certification.

sources.title: 墾務局填築施工設計標準
sources.titleEn: Design Standards 13, Chapter 10: Embankment Construction
sources.scope: 二〇一二年章節支持含水量、試驗填築、分層夯實及品質控制；壩體指引轉作土堤機理參考，不當地方堤防驗收標準。
sources.scopeEn: The 2012 chapter supports moisture, test fills, lift compaction and quality control; dam guidance is used for embankment mechanics, not local levee acceptance criteria.

sources.title: 墾務局保護濾層設計標準
sources.titleEn: Design Standards 13, Chapter 5: Protective Filters
sources.scope: 二〇一一年章節支持基土選擇、保土、排水與施工連續性；單一粒徑比不等於完整濾層合格判定。
sources.scopeEn: The 2011 chapter supports base-soil selection, retention, drainage and construction continuity; one grain-size ratio is not a complete filter acceptance test.

sources.title: 墾務局滲流設計標準
sources.titleEn: Design Standards 13, Chapter 8: Seepage
sources.scope: 二〇一四年章節支持滲流概念、模型與觀測；簡化一維算式不替代分層地基或繞流分析。
sources.scopeEn: The 2014 chapter supports seepage concepts, models and observation; simplified one-dimensional equations do not replace layered-foundation or bypass-flow analysis.

sources.title: 西沙加緬度退縮堤截水牆完成公告
sources.titleEn: West Sacramento Setback Levee Cutoff Completion
sources.scope: 核對二〇一三年十二月截水牆完成、堤體前一年完成及仍待後續工程；不與南港其他工程段混同。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies December 2013 cutoff completion, embankment completion the preceding year and remaining follow-on work; it is not conflated with other Southport reaches.

sources.title: 波士頓防潮屏障及防線連續工程
sources.titleEn: Boston Barrier Scheme and Defence Continuity
sources.scope: 二〇二五年更新確認主閘二〇二〇年完成、二〇二一年首次防潮操作；全案仍有後續工程，不能寫成全案二〇二〇年竣工。
sources.scopeEn: The 2025 update confirms primary-gate completion in 2020 and first protective operation in 2021; remaining works prevent a claim of whole-scheme completion in 2020.

sources.title: 工兵團防洪牆與水工擋土牆手冊書目
sources.titleEn: Flood Walls and other Hydraulic Retaining Walls, EM 1110-2-2502
sources.scope: 官方目錄核對二〇二二年八月一日版本及設計維護範圍；全文取得受限，未聲稱逐條核實承載準則。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalogue verifies the 1 August 2022 edition and design/maintenance scope; full-text access was restricted, so no clause-by-clause bearing criteria are claimed.

sources.title: 比尤德利塞文河防洪設施維護
sources.titleEn: Bewdley Severnside Flood-defence Maintenance
sources.scope: 二〇二〇年公告核對南北區固定牆、可拆擋板及抽水站與接縫維護；北區二〇〇四、南區二〇〇六完工。
sources.scopeEn: The 2020 release verifies fixed walls, demountables, pumps and joint maintenance; north and south schemes completed in 2004 and 2006 respectively.

sources.title: 比尤德利比爾斯角防洪工程啟用
sources.titleEn: Beales Corner Flood Risk Management Operational Completion
sources.scope: 核對二〇二五年九月十二日營運完工、固定牆與可拆構件組合及異地儲存；細部景觀工作當時仍續作。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies operational completion on 12 September 2025, combined fixed and removable elements and off-site storage; minor landscaping continued at that time.

sources.title: 科隆萊茵河固定及活動防洪構造
sources.titleEn: Cologne Rhine Fixed and Mobile Flood Structures
sources.scope: 官方營運頁核對萊茵河固定牆、移動構件及高程別部署；本課不複製實際啟動水位或宣稱其全球通用。
sources.scopeEn: The operator page verifies fixed walls, mobile elements and stage-dependent deployment along the Rhine; lessons do not copy operating triggers or generalize them worldwide.

limits: All lesson numerical values are original hypothetical inputs, not field control settings or project measurements.
Guide/model references and owner case histories have separate scopes.
Supplier case statements are attributed; institutions are technical associations, not inferred contractors.
Dates describe verified publication or reported historical events, not unverified completion claims.
